title: Pricy for a sticky mold. Disappointed.
text: Pricy for a sticky mold. Disappointed.. I use this brand for cookie baking, and thought it would be great to use them for fluted cakes.  I used a muffin recipe that had oil in it, so I didn’t think I needed to oil the mould.  Wrong.  They were stuck and hmm, not happy.  I tried it again with a carrot cake mix, same issue.  Tried it 3rd time with light oiling of the mould: came out better.  Kinda expected a lot more of non stick feature of this mold. Not worth the high price.

product_metadata.title: Silpat Perfect Mini Fluted Cake Mold

description: Silpat baking molds are perfect for baking just about any delicacy you want. The baking molds are made of non-stick silicone which means you’ll spend less time cleaning and more time enjoying your baking creations. Silpat replaces the need for butter, grease, oils, and sprays.
